title: 2D convolution forward pass
summary: A multi-channel conv2d with stride, zero padding and bias, plus the output size formula, written with loops and numpy.

mutants.flip_kernel: Flips the kernel in both spatial axes, which is true convolution. Deep learning layers use cross-correlation.
mutants.stride_ignored: Slides the window one pixel at a time, so stride has no effect on which positions are read.
mutants.pad_one_side: Pads only the top and left of the image, so the output is shifted.
mutants.first_channel_only: Uses only the first input channel and does not sum over the input channels.
